$comment: Allowlist for check_asset_registry_catalog_status.py (D-CND-13; NIRMANA issues #1753/#1807). Entries are APPLIED migrations that predate the rule; they cannot be edited. A NEW migration omitting catalog_status must be FIXED, not added here.

Its data was swept by migration 294 and re-swept by this campaign's per-layer DRAFT->CURRENT migrations, and PR #1813 now keeps CURRENT durable through a re-seed. Allowlisted so the guard blocks NEW omissions immediately rather than waiting on a rewrite that is forbidden.
